_comment: One job per STRIP — the whole strip as one image, for the concept run. Run with comic_render.py --provider runway|google|openai.

jobs.title: Lincoln City
jobs.prompt: a single full-page comic drawing (1 panels). Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. Title of the strip: ROFLCOPTER. The strip: 101 north through Lincoln City from a bus window he never sat at: outlet stores, a kite shop, the D River sign, the sea in the gaps. The page puts the town's clutter in and keeps the seat's reflection empty. Panel 1: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window from inside showing a coastal town's roadside passing with a kite shop and a small bridge sign and gray sea in the gaps between buildings, the glass reflecting an empty seat, no words legible. No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @chloe_44 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_48 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @the_bird is the model sheet for THE BIRD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @chloe_44 for the character the strip's Chloe at 44; @gully_48 for the character the strip's Gully at 41-48; @the_bird for the character the bird.
